opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)

amount.raw: up to £500,000; in special cases up to £750,000; most grants below £300,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to UK-based organisations/institutions. Not available to individuals without a formal employment or contractual relationship with the hosting institution; projects led by individuals unaffiliated to an organisation; projects led by schools or further education colleges; projects led by undergraduates or master's students; PhD fees or projects whose main purpose is to support a PhD; local charities, replacement for statutory funding, or local social services/social welfare provision. In exceptional cases overseas organisations may apply if no UK-based host is feasible.
opportunities.summary: Funding for research projects that address one or more of the Foundation's five interconnected priority questions and aim to improve lives in the UK. Assessment criteria cover relevance, impact, conceptual framework, rigour, experience, and value for money. Two application deadlines a year (Spring and Autumn).

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Encourages applicants from diverse backgrounds, particularly individuals and organisations from racially minoritised communities. Strongly encourages partnership applications bringing together researchers and racially minoritised communities.
opportunities.summary: Research funding to understand the barriers and pathways to a racially just and inclusive society. Supports research on racial diversity within the UK. 2026 priority theme: inter-generational changes, continuities and challenges in racially diverse UK. Funded by an endowment supporting work relating to the Commonwealth.
